batches.note: Open-air opening beat (owner directive 2026-08-04, /new-delve open-air rule), as far as the valley horizon currently allows. The roof comes off the entry hall: Barrowmere's gate yard stands open to the sky, so the delve opens under cherry-grove daylight and biome tint instead of glowstone in a sealed box, and every later beat stays interior on purpose. The fuller staging the directive asks for — walls down on the two faces that front the gap floor, so the party spawns looking at the cherry rim — is authored and proven correct in geometry (the keep walk plane and the valley gap floor are the same plane by the spec-0026 datum equation, both top y=63, and the gap floor begins one column out at x=-1 / z=-5) but is blocked upstream: letting the party onto the gap floor makes the whole surround reachable, and the annulus perimeter is an unfenced drop into void (DW0322, ~346 columns). It lands as soon as the surround gains outer-edge containment.
